changes.title: Could Life Exist Under The Ice Of Europa?
changes.beforeHead:
Could Life Exist Under The Ice Of Europa?

Orbit flies to Jupiter's cracked white moon — and into the dark ocean under the ice. Why the shell doesn't freeze solid, what could live without sunlight, the fingerprints on the frost, and why Europa Clipper is already on its way.

A wonder-led cosmic journey: liquid water, chemistry without daylight, and the careful next look so we don't spoil the answe

changes.title: What Happens When the Last Star Dies?
changes.beforeHead:
What Happens When the Last Star Dies? | Orbit's Cosmic Journey

Orbit rides deep time to the last star in the universe — and asks what remains when even that light fails.

Heat death explained without dreadbait: why stars stop being born, why red dwarfs outlive the Sun, and what "the end" actually means in physics. Real observations, honest uncertainty, and wonder without fearbait.
